name: Water for the row
text: Four jugs and two bars. Pay on delivery, not before.

name: Last puck on row C
text: Row C is down to its last puck. Whatever you can spare.

name: Weekly rations
text: Same as last week. Same as every week.

name: A lamp for the bunk
text: The corridor lights went dim. We would like our own.

name: Scrubber bank is down
text: Bank 4 has stopped. Filters, any filters, today.
notes: Spawned by the scrubber failure events; weight 0 in the normal draw.

name: Tools for the ducts
text: A knife, pliers, tape. Duct work eats all three.

name: Cells and cable
text: Three small cells and cable. I will trade scrap if you prefer.

name: A hot week
text: Bad week in the ducts. Porridge and water, please.

name: Tug stores
text: Stores for the next run. Eight bars, four tins, four jugs.

name: Cells for the tug
text: Charged, and I mean charged. The last batch died at the ice.

name: Ore crane repair
text: Crane two seized. Bearings and a motor before the next tug.

name: Ice cutter parts
text: Cutters are dull and the crew is angry. Parts.

name: Tools for the second shift
text: Two wrenches, a jam kit, grease. Foreman signs on delivery.

name: Burn kit
text: Splash on the third pour. Gel, tabs, bandage.

name: Mill bearings
text: Mill two runs hot. Bearings and coolant, fast.

name: Spent water filters
text: Four spent filters. The shop rewinds them for the cooling loop.

name: Shift meds
text: Pills for the hands and something for the burns.

name: Hot meals
text: Hot stew and noodles. Crew has been on cold paste.

name: Yeast and sugar
text: Yeast, sugar. For the bread. Honestly.
notes: Also what a still wants; the buyer says bread.

name: Circuit stock
text: Anything that works. Test them first.

name: Manuals and a handbook
text: Two manuals and the handbook. Mine are in pieces.

name: Blank floppies
text: Blank floppies, three. Not the ones with the bad sector.

name: Device models
text: Build to the attached model. Samples first, then we talk volume.

name: Algae tanks
text: Tank two is browning. Nutrient, starter, a fresh sensor.

name: Ward stock
text: Standard ward restock. Count them twice.

name: Wound table
text: Dressing, antiseptic, sutures. A bad shift.

name: Isolation ward
text: Ward packs and antivirals for the isolation room.

name: Cells for the crew
text: Cells, charged. Core crew burns them in a night.

name: Reactor spares
text: Plant needs spares before the next shift. Do not be late.

name: Control chips
text: Chips and one memory module. Do not drop them.

name: Night shift
text: Odd hours. Tabs, stew, a torch.

name: Coolant, weekly
text: Same as last week. The plant eats coolant.

name: Antirad for the crew
text: Antirad tabs, six. Dosimeters ticked again.

name: Form slips
text: Twenty slips and two label rolls. The forms never end.

name: Paper and ledgers
text: Paper, ledgers, a notice board sheet. Company stock.

name: Office comfort
text: The office is cold. Cushions, blanket, lamps.

name: Store shelving
text: The store terminals are down. Screen, circuits, housing.

name: Wine for tonight
text: Guests tonight. Wine and a bottle of the good spirit.

name: Something fresh
text: Real apples, herbs, tomatoes. Not vat-grown, please.

name: Sail panels
text: The sail panel is cracked. We would like the sun back.

name: The ring dinner
text: A proper table for six. Wine and a scent for the room.

name: Old paper
text: Books, a photograph, a locket. Provenance matters.

name: A real flame
text: I am told you can find candles. I did not ask.

name: Model for a print
text: A print and a small sculpture. Model attached, if you want a template.

name: A watch and a box
text: A watch that ticks and a box that plays. Price is no object.

name: Back-room still
text: Four bottles of the clear stuff. Do not label it.

name: Dream tabs
text: Six loose and two cards. No questions.

name: Quiet goods
text: A noble bar and a dongle. Do not ask where they went.

name: Lighters
text: Lighters, fluid, a striker. Fire sells.

name: Company tithe, phase 1
text: Tithe for the week: forty credits of rations to the company store. Late tithe is docked from wages.
notes: One tithe template per phase; the want is a need value, book rate 0.25 of market. Penalty is soft by default (STATION 7).

name: Company tithe, phase 2
text: Tithe for the week: three hundred credits of spares to the company yard. Failure to deliver is noted.
notes: One tithe template per phase; the want is a need value, book rate 0.25 of market. Penalty is soft by default (STATION 7).

name: Company tithe, phase 3
text: Tithe for the week: three thousand credits of charged cells to the plant. Penalty applies after day seven.
notes: One tithe template per phase; the want is a need value, book rate 0.25 of market. Penalty is soft by default (STATION 7).

name: Company tithe, phase 4
text: Tithe for the week: thirty thousand credits of company-grade goods. You are part of the supply now.
notes: One tithe template per phase; the want is a need value, book rate 0.25 of market. Penalty is soft by default (STATION 7).

name: Rent due
text: Rent is due on the stall. Five a day. Late rent is added to the tithe.
notes: Memo, no wants. Phase 1 rent is 5 a day.

name: New rent schedule
text: Your stall rent is revised in line with turnover. See the schedule at the store.

name: Wage notice
text: Wage scale adjustments take effect next cycle. Complaints to the clerk.

name: Dock records
text: Dock records are now kept by disc. A copy is attached for authorised stalls.

name: New label standard
text: All goods for company stores must carry the company label. Template attached.

name: Company contract
text: A hull repair contract. Attached are the machine plans for the job.

name: Clinic staples
text: Quarterly staples. Please send in one box.

name: Free ward
text: The free ward has nothing left. Whatever you can send.

name: Weekly dressings
text: Weekly dressings, same as before.

name: Antibiotic trial
text: A new culture protocol. Disc attached.

name: Regrowth cases
text: Two regrowth cases on the ward. Protocol disc attached.

name: Fever ward rush
text: Fever has filled the ward. Anything with a label, today.

name: Hall bread
text: Bread, porridge and yeast for the halls. Union rates.

name: Strike notice
text: Works hands down tools at the next shift. Parts will be slow.

name: Filter returns
text: Spent filters and pucks, back for the recycler. Weights agreed.

name: Hall manuals
text: Three machine manuals. The new hires cannot read the old ones.

name: Vat valves
text: Vat room three is leaking. Valves, pipe, a motor.

name: Founders feast
text: Wine and spirit for the founders feast. Delivered, chilled.

name: A complaint
text: The council notes with regret that deliveries to the ring are late.

name: Gifts of state
text: Gifts for the visiting board. Real metal only.

name: Farm glass
text: A pane has cracked over bed six. Lamps and glass, please.

name: Pickup notice
text: Next general pickup is posted. Sealed boxes in the dock by then.

name: Account letter
text: Your account has reached a new tier. Terms attached, effective now.

name: Packing stock
text: Crates, padding, tape. We run short every week.

name: Fire plans
text: Candles and matches. Plans for a better flame enclosed.

name: Narcotics notes
text: Tabs and ampoules. Notes on the process enclosed.

name: Cracked tools
text: Two blank cards. A tool is enclosed. Use at your own risk.

name: Black exchange
text: A memory module. The exchange program is enclosed.

name: Back-room stock
text: Six bottles. No labels, no names.

name: FREE WINE inside
text: Free wine, free music, free everything. Open the disc.
notes: Spam: the attached disc carries mod_infected.

name: Dock offer
text: Dock job, no questions. The disc has the details.
notes: Spam: the attached disc carries mod_infected.

name: Inspection notice
text: An inspection of stalls on the mid decks is scheduled. Declare nothing, hide nothing.

name: Seizure order
text: Items of fire class are subject to seizure. Fines apply.

name: Security stores
text: Alarms, a lock, torches. Invoice the company.

name: Bars for the fab hall
text: Four iron bars for the fab hall. The Company's own are late again.

name: Copper for the windings
text: Two copper bars. The reactor's windings will not wait for the convoy.

name: Sheet and wire
text: Sheet and wire, rolled and drawn. Whatever the bench turns out.

name: Clean water for the row
text: Six of clean, not grey. The row has been boiling greywater for a week.

name: Fresh herbs
text: Fresh herbs for the table, grown under a lamp, not out of a tube.
